description: Checks up to 20 BrainVault card refs (v3:N) at once, for citing cards in answers. For each ref: exists, public (text readable), sha256_ok (on-chain text matches its fingerprint), creator (minting address) and official (minted by a Wave signer). Read-only, free, no key. Use card_read to get a card's text.

refs.description: Up to 20 card refs like v3:142, as a list (or one comma-separated string)

name: verify_citations
title: Verify card citations
